title: Platform Overview
summary: How Blastrr's simulated crypto trading accounts, wallet access, and market data work.

groups.title: What Blastrr Provides
paragraphs: Blastrr provides simulated crypto trading accounts with plan rules, a browser-based trading terminal, and account and profile tools. Trading balances, orders, positions, and performance are simulated.
The terminal uses live market data for configured Binance Spot pairs as a reference for simulated prices. Simulated orders are not sent to Binance or another live exchange.

groups.title: Wallet-Based Access
items: Connect a compatible Web3 wallet and sign the requested message to access the app.
The connected wallet identifies the accounts and profile available in your dashboard.
Email and password sign-in are not currently offered.

groups.title: What the Platform Does Not Provide
items: Blastrr is not a brokerage account and does not provide live exchange execution.
Plan capital and trade results are simulated; they are not user deposits or investment returns.
A plan target or simulated profit does not guarantee a reward, payout, or financial return.

title: Getting Started
summary: Connect a wallet, choose a plan, select an account, and use the simulated trading terminal.

groups.title: Connect and Purchase
items: Open the app and connect a compatible Web3 wallet. Sign the access message shown by the app.
Review available plans and their current rules on the Buy Plans page.
Select a supported USDT payment network in the app, complete checkout, and wait for confirmation before checking My Accounts.
Verify the token, destination, network, and final amount in your wallet before confirming a payment.

groups.title: Select an Account and Market
items: Choose an active account from Select your account in the order-entry card.
Select a market from the terminal's market selector. Only pairs listed there are available.
Use the bottom scrolling ticker to review live prices for configured Binance Spot pairs; clicking a pair selects it in the terminal.

groups.title: Place a Simulated Trade
items: Enter margin and choose one of the execution multipliers offered by the order ticket.
Optionally enter Stop Loss and Take Profit prices.
Review the reference price, position notional, available balance, and risk information.
Choose Buy / Long or Sell / Short to submit a simulated trade.

groups.title: Need Help?
paragraphs: For account, payment, or app issues, use the support ticket controls in Profile & Promos. Include relevant transaction or request details, but never share a seed phrase or private key.

title: Trading Markets
summary: The Binance Spot USDT pairs currently listed in the terminal and the market data they display.

groups.title: Configured Binance Spot Pairs
paragraphs: The terminal currently lists the following 20 Binance Spot pairs, each quoted in USDT. The market selector and ticker are the source of truth if availability changes.

groups.title: Market Data
items: The terminal's selected-market bar shows mid price, bid/ask, 24-hour percentage change, high, low, and quote volume in USDT.
The scrolling bottom ticker shows price and 24-hour percentage change from Binance Spot streaming ticker data for configured pairs.
Market data is provided for reference in the simulated terminal. Data delays, exchange availability, and simulated execution can cause differences from a live exchange.

groups.title: Availability
paragraphs: Crypto markets are generally available 24 hours a day, seven days a week. Binance, network, or Blastrr maintenance and service interruptions may temporarily affect data or access.

title: Trade Entry & Controls
summary: The controls available for simulated Buy/Long and Sell/Short trades.

groups.title: Order Entry
paragraphs: The current order ticket submits a simulated Buy / Long or Sell / Short trade using the displayed live reference price. Use the controls currently shown in the ticket.
items: Select an active account and one of the listed Spot markets.
Enter a margin amount and choose an available execution multiplier: 1x, 2x, 5x, 10x, 20x, or 50x.
Optionally enter Stop Loss and Take Profit price levels.
Review the reference price, notional estimate, and available balance before submitting.

groups.title: Position Monitoring
items: Review open positions and their simulated entry, margin, notional, Stop Loss/Take Profit, and live PnL in Open Positions & PnL.
The displayed price is a market-data reference. Simulated results may differ from live exchange execution.
Use only the account and trade controls currently shown in the app.

groups.title: Position Size and Leverage
paragraphs: The order ticket uses the entered margin and selected multiplier to calculate simulated position notional. A higher multiplier increases notional exposure and magnifies the effect of price movements on simulated PnL.
Use the account balance and risk limits shown in the app. A displayed estimate is not a guarantee of execution or account outcome.

title: Account Plans & Risk Rules
summary: Current straight-to-funded simulated plan sizes, targets, and account risk parameters.

groups.title: Current Plan Parameters
paragraphs: The current plans provide simulated capital without a separate evaluation phase. Plan purchase prices and discounts are managed separately and may change; use the live Buy Plans page for current pricing.

groups.title: Daily Loss Limit
paragraphs: The daily loss limit is based on the account's daily starting balance and resets at the UTC day boundary. A daily-limit breach temporarily locks the account until the earlier of 24 hours after the lock or the next UTC midnight.

groups.title: Maximum Loss Floor
paragraphs: The current implementation calculates the maximum-loss floor from the account high-water mark, with the high-water mark capped at 110% of initial balance. The floor may rise with the high-water mark up to the initial balance; it does not rise above initial balance. Reaching the floor can permanently lock the account.

groups.title: Profit Target and Consistency
paragraphs: The plan profit target is an account metric, not a promise of earnings or payment. The configured plans also set a 40% maximum single-day share of accumulated profit for reward eligibility. Reward requests remain subject to current rules and review.

title: Payments & Account Access
summary: Paying for a plan with USDT, supported networks, account provisioning, and promotional codes.

groups.title: USDT Plan Payments
paragraphs: Plan purchases use USDT through the network selected in the app. The homepage and checkout list the supported networks; availability and configuration may change.
items: Select the network in the app before checkout.
Confirm the token, network, destination, and amount in your wallet before signing or sending.
Blockchain transactions may be irreversible. Do not send funds to a simulated trading balance or an address not provided by the purchase flow.

groups.title: Finding a Purchased Account
paragraphs: After a purchase is confirmed and the account is provisioned, the account appears under My Accounts. If it is missing, refresh the app and submit a support ticket with the transaction hash and network. Do not repeat a payment while the first transaction is being checked.

groups.title: Promotional Codes
items: Eligible creator or promotional discount codes can be entered in Buy Plans; checkout shows the applied offer and final amount.
One-time free-account codes are claimed from Profile & Promos and provision the plan attached to that code.
Code availability, eligibility, and use limits are shown by the app and current promotion terms.

title: Rewards, Referrals & BlastrrPass
summary: The app's referral, creator application, simulated reward request, and XP/points features.

groups.title: Referral and Creator Features
items: Profile & Promos displays your referral code and shareable link when available.
You can apply to become a creator by submitting social profile links and community details. Applications can be edited and are reviewed by the Blastrr team.
Approval and any custom referral commission are not automatic; the profile displays the commission configured for your account.

groups.title: BlastrrPass
paragraphs: BlastrrPass tracks XP, points, rank, missions, and available rewards. Eligible missions and plan-purchase awards are configured by administrators and shown in the app.
items: Complete an eligible mission or other activity described in the app to receive its configured award.
Rank thresholds, reward availability, and redemption rules are shown in BlastrrPass and may change.
A profile username is required to share your rank card through the app's X share control.

groups.title: Reward and Withdrawal Requests
paragraphs: The app may provide account reward or withdrawal request controls. Available balances, protected amounts, request types, and status shown in your account are authoritative. Requests may be reviewed before processing.
Simulated performance does not guarantee a reward, withdrawal, or financial return. Review the current platform terms and eligibility requirements before submitting a request.

title: Safety, Availability & Support
summary: Protecting your wallet, handling service interruptions, and getting account help.

groups.title: Wallet Safety
items: Never share a wallet seed phrase or private key with anyone, including support.
Verify the domain, transaction destination, token, network, and amount before approving a payment.
Only sign messages or transactions you understand and initiated.

groups.title: Market Data and Service Interruptions
paragraphs: Market prices depend on Binance Spot data and network connectivity. If prices stop updating, refresh the app and wait for the feed to recover before relying on a quote.
Blastrr administrators may place individual pages into maintenance. During an outage, follow the message shown in the app rather than assuming a specific return time.

groups.title: Support
paragraphs: Use the support ticket feature in Profile & Promos for account, purchase, or platform issues. Include relevant transaction or request identifiers, but never include confidential wallet credentials.

groups.title: Simulated Trading Notice
paragraphs: Blastrr account balances, orders, positions, and PnL are simulated. Market data and simulated fills may not reflect real-market execution, liquidity, slippage, or trading conditions. Nothing on the platform is a guarantee of future performance or payment.
